arxiv-2009-00178.title: Dynamically Formed Black Hole Binaries: In-Cluster Versus Ejected Mergers DOI: 10.1017/pas.2026.xxx
arxiv-2009-00178.creator: O. Anagnostou 1, M. Trenti 1,2 and A. Melatos 1,2
arxiv-2009-00178.description: Abstract The growing number of black hole binary (BHB) mergers detected by the Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory (LIGO) have the potential to enable an unprecedented characterization of the physical processes and astrophysical conditions that govern the formation of compact binaries.

arxiv-2105-06564.title: Physical Artificial Intelligence: The Concept Expansion of Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence
arxiv-2105-06564.creator: Yingbo Li, Yucong Duan*, Anamaria-Beatrice Spulber, Haoyang Che, Zakaria Maamar, Zhao Li, Chen Yang, Yu lei
arxiv-2105-06564.description: Abstract Artificial Intelligence has been a growth catalyst to our society and is cosidered across all idustries as a fundamental technology. However, its development has been limited to the signal processing domain that relies on the generated and collected data from other sensors.

arxiv-2106-04802.title: Probabilistic task modelling for meta-learning
arxiv-2106-04802.creator: Cuong Nguyen, Thanh-Toan Do, Gustavo Carneiro
arxiv-2106-04802.description: Abstract We propose probabilistic task modelling – a generative probabilistic model for collections of tasks used in meta-learning. The proposed model combines variational auto-encoding and latent Dirichlet allocation to model each task as a mixture of Gaussian distribution in an embedding space. Such modelling provides an explicit representation of a task through its task-theme mixture.

arxiv-2207-04646.title: DelightfulTTS 2: End-to-End Speech Synthesis with Adversarial Vector-Quantized Auto-Encoders
arxiv-2207-04646.creator: Yanqing Liu, Ruiqing Xue, Lei He, Xu Tan, Sheng Zhao
arxiv-2207-04646.description: Abstract Current text to speech (TTS) systems usually leverage a cascaded acoustic model and vocoder pipeline with mel-spectrograms as the intermediate representations, which suffer from two limitations: 1) the acoustic model and vocoder are separately trained instead of jointly optimized, which incurs cascaded errors; 2) the intermediate speech representations (e.g., mel-spectrogram) are pre-designed and lose phase information, which are sub-optimal.

arxiv-2208-13461.title: Integral formulas for a foliated sub-Riemannian manifold
arxiv-2208-13461.creator: Vladimir Rovenski
arxiv-2208-13461.description: Abstract In this article, we deduce a series of integral formulas for a foliated sub-Riemannian manifold, which is a new geometric concept denoting a Riemannian manifold equipped with a distribution 𝒟 {\mathcal{D}} and a foliation ℱ {\mathcal{F}} , whose tangent bundle is a subbundle of 𝒟 {\mathcal{D}} .

arxiv-2210-14881.title: Frequency stability of cryogenic silicon cavities with semiconductor crystalline coatings Journal: optica Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2210-14881.creator: Dhruv Kedar, 1,* Jialiang Yu, 2 Eric Oelker, 1,3 Alexander Staron, 1 William R. Milner, 1 John M. Robinson, 1 Thomas Legero, 2 Fritz Riehle, 2 Uwe Sterr, 2 and Jun Ye 1
arxiv-2210-14881.description: Abstract State-of-the-art optical oscillators employing cryogenic reference cavities are limited in performance by the Brownian thermal noise associated with the mechanical dissipation of the mirror coatings. Recently, crystalline Al 1-x Ga x As/GaAs coatings have emerged as a promising candidate for improved coating thermal noise.

arxiv-2309-11038.title: CaveSeg: Deep Semantic Segmentation and Scene Parsing for Autonomous Underwater Cave Exploration Thanks: This pre-print is accepted for publication at ICRA 2024. Thanks: Project: https://robopi.ece.ufl.edu/caveseg.html
arxiv-2309-11038.creator: Adnan Abdullah, Titon Barua, Reagan Tibbetts, Zijie Chen, Md Jahidul Islam, Ioannis Rekleitis adnanabdullah@ufl.edu, baruat@email.sc.edu, rbt@email.sc.edu,chen.zijie@ufl.edu, jahid@ece.ufl.edu, yiannisr@cse.sc.edu
arxiv-2309-11038.description: Abstract In this paper, we present CaveSeg - the first visual learning pipeline for semantic segmentation and scene parsing for AUV navigation inside underwater caves. We address the problem of scarce annotated training data by preparing a comprehensive dataset for semantic segmentation of underwater cave scenes. It contains pixel annotations for important navigation markers ( e.g .

arxiv-2310-01239.title: Dislocation dynamics in Ni-based superalloys: Parameterising dislocation trajectories from atomistic simulations Journal: Journal of Computational Physics
arxiv-2310-01239.creator: Geraldine Anis, Thomas Hudson, Peter Brommer
arxiv-2310-01239.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Geraldine Anis, Thomas Hudson, Peter Brommer. Nanoscale precipitates in the microstructure of nickel-based superalloys hinder dislocation motion, which results in an extraordinary strengthening effect at elevated temperatures. We used molecular dynamics (MD) with classical effective potential to observe the movement of an a 2 ​ ⟨ 110 ⟩ ​ { 111 } \frac{a}{2}\langle 110\rangle\{111\} edge dislocation under shear in pure Ni, which represents the Ni solid solution matrix, and extracted the locations of the dislocations.

arxiv-2505-07413.title: Learning Penalty for Optimal Partitioning via Automatic Feature Extraction
arxiv-2505-07413.creator: Tung L Nguyen, Toby Dylan Hocking
arxiv-2505-07413.description: Abstract Changepoint detection identifies significant shifts in data sequences, making it important in areas like finance, genetics, and healthcare. The Optimal Partitioning algorithms efficiently detect these changes, using a penalty parameter to limit the changepoints count. Determining the optimal value for this penalty can be challenging.

arxiv-2512-16222.title: Long-lived particle production through the PRISM
arxiv-2512-16222.creator: Kevin J. Kelly, Mudit Rai
arxiv-2512-16222.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kevin J. Kelly, Mudit Rai. Accelerator-based neutrino experiments offer a competitive environment to search for long-lived particles with sub-GeV masses. Yet, many theoretical models involving such particles predict very similar phenomenology and nearly identical final-state signatures. In view of this, we study the capabilities of upcoming experiments – specifically the DUNE near detectors – to distinguish between different classes of long-lived particles and the mechanisms by which they are produces.

nasir-khusraw-sefer-nameh-schefer-1881.title: Sefer Nameh
nasir-khusraw-sefer-nameh-schefer-1881.creator: Nasir-i Khusraw (Charles Schefer, trans.)
nasir-khusraw-sefer-nameh-schefer-1881.description: The 11th-century Persian traveler's seven-year journey through the Islamic world — Schefer's French translation.

pmc-10612475.title: False-positive Imaging for Papillary Thyroid Cancer Caused by Intraosseous Hemangiomas
pmc-10612475.creator: Heejoo Kang, Frederick Thurston Drake, David McAneny, Stephanie L Lee
pmc-10612475.description: Two patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma and an elevated thyroglobulin had false-positive imaging studies from intraosseous hemangiomas (IH). A 62-year-old man presented with a palpable lytic skull mass suspicious for a bone metastasis after computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans. Surgical excision confirmed an IH.

pmc-10727854.title: A Case of Cavernous Sinus Syndrome Due to Extranodal Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
pmc-10727854.creator: Tae-Rim Kim, Kyung-Nam Bae, Jin-Hwa Son, Kihyuk Shin, Hoonsoo Kim, Hyunchang Ko, Byungsoo Kim, Moon-Bum Kim
pmc-10727854.description: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is the most common type of non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma accounting for approximately one-third of all cases. DLBCL can present as a lymph node or extranodal tumor. Cavernous sinus (CS) is a small but complex structure in which various arteries, sympathetic plexuses, and cranial nerves are passing through.

pmc-12437870.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Culturally Adapted Persian-Translated PEERS® (Program for the Education and Enrichment of Relational Skills) for Young Adults with ASD : A Mixed-Methods Study
pmc-12437870.creator: M Motamed, J Alaghband-rad, S Jamaloo, N Tavakkolian, R Amin, N Khosravanmehr
pmc-12437870.description: IntroductionSocial deficits are a significant impairment in adult ASD, leading to difficulties in socio-emotional cognition, communication, and relationships. Effective social skills interventions are crucial during the transition to adulthood. The UCLA PEERS® (Program for the Education and Enrichment of Relational Skills) for young adults is a prominent and well-researched intervention, implemented in over eighty countries and translated into numerous languages.

pmc-12563829.title: Understanding the Colloidal and Hydration Control in Rheological Evolution of 3D Printed MgO-SiO2-K2HPO4 Gel System
pmc-12563829.creator: Xianhuan Cai, Fan Chen, Zhihui Zhao, Peng Xiao, Yujuan Zhang
pmc-12563829.description: Monitoring the time-dependent rheological properties of 3D printed MgO-SiO2-K2HPO4 is critical for optimizing the dynamic structural reconstruction ability. The collaborative analysis for the contribution of colloidal force based on EDLVO theory and the volume fraction of K-struvite (MgKPO4·6H2O) was conducted.

pmc-12729111.title: Home-based rehabilitation using wearable motion tracker with smart phone application feedback is as effective as conventional self-directed rehabilitation after total knee arthroplasty: randomized controlled trial
pmc-12729111.creator: Seok Jin Jung, Ji Hoon Kim, Seung Joon Rhee
pmc-12729111.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the effectiveness and pain improvement of self-directed rehabilitation (SDR) using a wearable motion tracker system (WMT) with smartphone application feedback after total knee arthroplasty.DesignA randomized controlled trial in institutional practice enrolled female patients who had undergone total knee arthroplasty.

pmc-12747995.title: Editorial: Mathematical modeling in discovery and analysis of immune responses
pmc-12747995.creator: Penelope A. Morel, Jaroslaw Smieja, Urszula Foryś
pmc-12747995.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). dels employed might take various forms – from relatively simple statistical formulae, through black-box models (including AI-based), agent based models, ordinary- and partial differential equations to multilevel models that combine multiple different approaches. Immunology is a field where such modeling may be particularly helpful, taking into account intertwined mechanisms involved in organism responses to viral or bacterial infections, autoimmune diseases, and immunotherapies.

pmc-12820377.title: Memory justifications provide valid indicators of retrieval accuracy across time
pmc-12820377.creator: Avi Gamoran, Zohar Raz Groman, Michael Gilead, Talya Sadeh
pmc-12820377.description: Human beings share in others’ experiences and learn from them, but epistemic vigilance is necessary to avoid being misled by false information, and to distinguish between veridical and non-veridical memories. Memory Justifications, individuals’ explanations for why they believe a recalled event truly occurred, help maintain epistemic vigilance regarding our memories.

pmc-12852736.title: Investigating action topography in visual cortex and deep artificial neural networks
pmc-12852736.creator: Davide Cortinovis, Nhut Truong, Hans Op de Beeck, Stefania Bracci
pmc-12852736.description: High-level visual cortex contains category-selective areas embedded within larger-scale topographic maps like animacy and real-world size. Here, we propose action as a key organizing factor shaping visual cortex topography and assess the ability of topographic deep artificial neural networks (DANNs) in capturing this organization.

pmc-12998603.title: Dopamine, Distraction, and Disruption: Perspectives on How Technology and Generation Z Are Reshaping Medical Education
pmc-12998603.creator: Bruno B Andrade, Mariana Araújo Pereira, Katia Avena
pmc-12998603.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This viewpoint reflects on how Generation Z (born between 1995 and 2009), shaped by constant digital engagement, a growing awareness of mental health, and a dopamine-driven environment, is transforming medical education and practice. We explore, from a reflective and interdisciplinary perspective, how the defining characteristics of Generation Z, such as their familiarity with technology, demand for emotional safety, and resistance to traditional hierarchies, might reshape the ways we teach, learn, and practice medicine.

pmc-13059383.title: PRDM1: a useful indicator of differentiation and prognosis in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-13059383.creator: Anqi Huang, Xingran Jiang, Yanan Qi, Jiaqi Chen, Xinmeng Guo, Jun Lu, Mulan Jin
pmc-13059383.description: BackgroundEsophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) is a common malignant tumor of the gastrointestinal tract with a high mortality rate. Although positive regulatory domain zinc finger protein 1 (PRDM1) has long been thought to play a key role especially in the differentiation of B cells, its role in ESCC has never been studied.

pmc-13206060.title: Body Roundness Index and Reported Vision Difficulty in U.S. Children and Adolescents: A Cross-Sectional Study of NHANES 2021–2023
pmc-13206060.creator: Jingwen Wang, Shuai Ouyang, Jia Qu, Ying Li
pmc-13206060.description: Background: Vision difficulty (VD) in childhood and adolescence may affect learning, daily functioning, and quality of life. Although body roundness index (BRI) has emerged as an indicator of central adiposity and cardiometabolic risk, its association with reported VD in pediatric populations remains unclear.

pmc-13275585.title: Women’s Autonomy and Respectful Maternity Care in Zambia: A Cross-Sectional Study Using Validated Patient-Reported Measures
pmc-13275585.creator: Atika Khalaf, Francis Sichimba, Kalunga Cindy Nakazwe, Lena Halawi
pmc-13275585.description: ObjectiveAlthough women’s autonomy is key to patient care, the extent to which patients exercise autonomy during clinical consultations in resource-limited contexts such as Zambia remains unknown. This study aimed to examine women’s experiences of autonomy in decision-making and respectful treatment in Zambian maternal healthcare.MethodsThe study was conducted in Lusaka and used a cross-sectional survey design.

pmc-13393858.title: Analysis of trait differences and identification of superior early growth combinations in interspecific hybrid progenies of Gleditsia sinensis
pmc-13393858.creator: Qingying Zeng, Xiurong Wang, Meixuan Xie, Fuhua Liu, Xingfu Zhang, Yang Zhao
pmc-13393858.description: Interspecific hybridization is a key strategy for germplasm innovation in Gleditsia, yet systematic evaluations of hybrid progeny at the seedling stage remain limited. Effective interspecific breeding relies not only on parental compatibility but also on the genetic plasticity and environmental adaptability of the resulting progeny.

pmc-13577982.title: Peripheral TDP-43 pathology in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: toward a systemic proteinopathy
pmc-13577982.creator: Philippe Codron, Marion Miranda, Maelle Garnier, Shiyang He, Julien Gouju, Julien Cassereau, Pascal Leblanc, Franck Letournel
pmc-13577982.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive degeneration of upper and lower motor neurons. Cytoplasmic accumulation of phosphorylated TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (pTDP-43) is the pathological hallmark of most ALS cases. While ALS has traditionally been viewed as a disease confined to the brain, spinal cord and motor nerves, recent studies have reported pTDP-43 pathology in multiple other tissues (skeletal and cardiac muscle, skin, minor salivary glands, gastrointestinal tract and lymph nodes), referred to as peripheral pathology.

pmc-13677965.title: Metabolomics reveals the effect of sand roasting, freeze-drying, and different hydrothermal treatments on the physical, functional and bioactive profile of Rice bean (Vigna umbellata)
pmc-13677965.creator: Somaina Basumatary, Manish Kumar Singh, Baby Zaithanpuii Hmar, Arvind Kumar, Jagan Karthik Sugumar, Ankur Aggarwal, Himanshu Mishra, Kumari Amita Singh, Satyender Singh Yadav, Sunil Kumar, Vishal Kumar
pmc-13677965.description: This study comprehensively investigated the effects of five processing treatments, namely soaking (SK), germination (GR), sand roasting (SR), freeze-drying (FD), and pressure cooking (PC) on the physicochemical, functional, structural, antioxidant, and metabolomic characteristics of rice bean (Vigna umbellata), an underutilised legume with high nutritional potential. Significant variations (p ≤ 0.05) were observed among treatments.
